subject.title: fix(security): exclude test files from plugin code-safety scans (#82469)

question: Should deep code-safety test-file exclusion apply only to plugin scans, or also to installed-skill scans through the shared helper?
rationale: The current diff resolves plugin test-file noise by changing a shared security-audit helper, which decides a broader `skills.code_safety` scan boundary than the linked report proves.

options.title: Narrow to plugin scans
options.body: Pass an explicit option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and set it only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving current installed-skill scan coverage.

options.title: Accept broader skill exclusion
options.body: Keep the shared-helper behavior only if maintainers explicitly accept that installed-skill test paths are out of deep code-safety scope and require proof for that boundary.

options.title: Pause for broader audit policy
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want string-literal masking or a larger audit false-positive policy to settle before landing this narrower fix.

recommendation.title: Narrow to plugin scans
recommendation.body: Pass an explicit option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and set it only from `collectPluginsCodeSafetyFindings`, preserving current installed-skill scan coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent security-audit hardening work is the strongest history signal for deciding this scan-scope boundary.
